text: The City of Toronto created positive impact across key Environment, Social, and Governance priorities this year, demonstrating commitment, innovation and transparency, through the performance disclosure and consideration of Environment, Social, and Governance risks and opportunities in the Environmental, Social, and Governance Performance Report ("ESG Report") for 2023 contained in Attachment 1. The objective of the Environment, Social, and Governance Report is to communicate Environment, Social, and Governance commitments, define targeted outcomes, and to account for progress towards sustainability, positive socioeconomic outcomes and good governance, as well as demonstrating transparency, accountability, participation, responsiveness, progress measurement and leadership.
